categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in cable television system management and broadband internet services, including digital video services, IPTV, and value-added smart home services. It also engages in telecommunications equipment research, design, sales, installation, and maintenance. The business segments include cable TV broadcasting, broadband internet provision, channel leasing, advertising, and related value-added services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes Fiber to the Home (FTTH) and Hybrid Fiber-Coaxial (HFC) network architectures, deploying advanced GPON and planning 10G-PON systems for high-speed broadband. It integrates 4K dual-mode set-top boxes based on Android TV platform to combine OTT and CATV services, enhancing interactive and smart home applications. The company also emphasizes network security with ISO27001/27011 certifications and employs big data analytics to optimize operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are residential households in New Taipei City (Banqiao, Tucheng, Zhonghe, Yonghe, Sanxia, Yingge, Shulin) and Kaohsiung City. The company serves cable TV subscribers, broadband internet users, and provides value-added services targeting families, including elderly care and smart home solutions. The market also includes partnerships with telecom operators and content providers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in northern and southern Taiwan, specifically in New Taipei City and Kaohsiung City, with licenses covering entire districts within these cities. It has expanded coverage to include Zhonghe, Yonghe, Sanxia, Yingge, and Shulin districts. The company also collaborates with Taiwan Broadband Communications (TBC) to extend broadband services in Taichung and the Taoyuan-Hsinchu-Miaoli region.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream and downstream player in the cable TV and broadband internet supply chain. It owns and manages the last-mile fiber optic network infrastructure connecting content providers and internet service providers to end consumers. It also leases circuits to telecom operators and provides value-added services to end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding FTTH network coverage, deploying 10G-PON technology, and enhancing broadband speed and quality. The company focuses on integrating OTT content with traditional cable TV via 4K dual-mode set-top boxes and developing smart home and smart city applications. It invests in cybersecurity, big data analytics, and customer service digitalization, aiming to increase user engagement and ARPU while maintaining subscriber growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through subscription fees for cable TV and broadband internet services, channel leasing fees, advertising income, installation and maintenance fees, and circuit leasing to telecom operators. The company also earns from value-added services such as smart home security products and OTT content subscriptions integrated into its platform.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces competition from other cable TV operators within its licensed areas, as well as from telecom operators like Chunghwa Telecom's MOD platform and various OTT streaming services including Netflix. Despite industry challenges, it maintains a leading market share in New Taipei City with approximately 68% cable TV penetration and continues to grow broadband subscribers. It positions itself as a key player in digital convergence and smart home services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues exceeding NT$20 billion for four consecutive years, with 2022 revenue at approximately NT$20.13 billion, showing stable growth. Net profit after tax was around NT$515.8 million with EPS of NT$3.48. Broadband subscribers reached 138,000 with over 60% penetration in operating areas. The company maintains a strong asset base with total assets around NT$7.79 billion and equity of NT$4.41 billion as of end 2022.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, stable FTTH broadband and integrated digital TV services with advanced 4K dual-mode set-top boxes offering OTT and CATV content. It differentiates through comprehensive smart home solutions, including security and elderly care, leveraging its dense fiber network as a critical last-mile infrastructure. Strong customer service, brand recognition with 'DaDa Broadband,' and continuous innovation in digital convergence and cybersecurity further enhance its competitive edge.
